# A different invoice for the same customer, spending — as a credit — the
# settlement another document's unpost left loose.
#
# Nothing here is this invoice's own orphan: the mark on that split names the
# other document. Whose orphan it is decides nothing, though. A bank paid that
# money and the split never said otherwise, so it is a settlement waiting to be
# put back rather than the customer's credit, and calling it one takes the
# basis off currency the bank still holds.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

invoice "INV-USD-OTHER"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Another job"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-OTHER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 100
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-02-25
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
		memo: "Settled from the credit on account"
